title: La Paloma
attribution: Habanera written about 1860 by the Basque composer Sebastián Iradier (Yradier, died 1865) after a visit to Cuba; he wrote both the melody and the Spanish words, so the song is public domain worldwide. Melody checked against the 1906 Century Music voice-and-piano edition; the triplets against the habanera beat are original, and the single F sharp ("que sí") is a chromatic neighbour note expected to show as out-of-key.
